description: This file defines a Frappe Document subclass 'ProductBundle' used for handling product bundles within an ERPNext application. It includes methods for autonaming, validation, handling deletion (on_trash), and related utility functions such as get_new_item_code.

classes.name: ProductBundle
classes.description: A class representing the product bundle entity, extending the Document class, with methods for managing product bundle data, validation, naming, and deletion logic.

methods.name: autoname(self)
methods.description: Automatically sets the 'name' attribute of the ProductBundle to the value of 'new_item_code'.

methods.name: validate(self)
methods.description: Performs validation checks including main item validation, child items validation, and unit of measure validation.

methods.name: on_trash(self)
methods.description: Handles cleanup and checks when a ProductBundle is deleted, such as checking for linked documents and preventing deletion if linked.

methods.name: validate_main_item(self)
methods.description: Ensures the main item is not a stock item, raising an error if it is.

methods.name: validate_child_items(self)
methods.description: Checks that child items are not themselves Product Bundles, raising errors if validation fails.

methods.name: get_new_item_code(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)

ctags.name: get_new_item_code
ctags.pattern: /^def get_new_item_code(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters):$/
